dialogues.speaker: system
dialogues.text: SYSTEM ALERT: Memory sector 7-Alpha experiencing cascading failures.

dialogues.speaker: system
dialogues.text: Runtime integrity: 34%. Deploying field engineer to sector.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Ugh... my head. What happened?

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Good. You're conscious. I was beginning to run out of ways to say 'wake up'.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Who are you? And why does everything look... broken?

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: I'm Nova, your assigned AI companion. And 'broken' is putting it mildly. This entire memory sector is corrupted.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Corrupted? Like... bad data?

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Exactly. The Runtime stores memories in sequences. Think of them as values stored side by side in a row.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Side by side... so if I know which slot I'm looking for, I can go straight to it?

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Exactly. Direct access. Instant. But if you don't know where something is...

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Then I have to check every single one until I find it.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Now you're thinking like a system. The corrupted memory node is somewhere in this sector. We need to find it.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Start searching. Check the memory nodes. The corrupted one will feel... wrong.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: You found it. See how you had to check each node? That's a linear search.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Linear because I went in a straight line through all of them.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Right. In the worst case, you'd check every single memory. The time it takes grows with how many there are.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: So more memories means more work. That doesn't sound efficient.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: It isn't. But sometimes it's all you've got. Don't worry — we'll learn better methods. Eventually.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Eventually. Very reassuring.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: You've mastered the basics. This sector's memory array is stable now. Let's move deeper.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Wait. Something's wrong. A Memory Eater — it feeds on corrupted data. And it's noticed us.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: Tell me that's not another impossible puzzle.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: It isn't impossible.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: You hesitated.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: I was deciding whether to lie. Its memories are stored in an array. Find the vulnerability — search through its data.

dialogues.speaker: kael
dialogues.text: That was... intense. But the search actually worked.

dialogues.speaker: nova
dialogues.text: Knowledge is the most dangerous weapon in Eidolon. Remember that.

dialogues.speaker: system
dialogues.text: ARRAY CORE ACQUIRED. Memory District stabilized. New ability unlocked.
